fix-e4d70fb7.note: Both tests fail at the parent only under SQLAlchemy 2.1.x (pinned 2.1.4 in pyproject/uv.lock since #8798, an ancestor of this commit). In 2.1, Select.filter_by resolves names against the FROM tables when the selected column is func.count(model.id), and a table's namespace has no association proxies, so it raises InvalidRequestError. Under 2.0.x it resolved against the mapped class, and the tests would very likely pass before the fix. The cached py envs under /root/.cache/eccode/mealie-envs that I checked hold only 2.0.x, so make sure this item's env is built from the parent's lockfile. I confirmed the 2.1.4 behaviour by reading the installed SQLAlchemy source in the uv cache, not by running it. The request names the SQLAlchemy upgrade as context, as a maintainer would; it does not describe the fix.
